INTRODUCTION 
 
I have researched and developed solutions for projects involving multimodal vision sensors, optimized for 
embedded platforms, performing data fusion, object detection, and segmentation. My recent research 
interests include image synthesis, image translation,, multimodal / multisource image registration and fusion,
